4dec8f5bfc1f3e71827c-r000.population: First marker on a nominated server/key to commit or abort applied there; spans completing in selected native epochs. Individual span starts are not logged; read-only/unresolved spans are not imputed

window.policy: Complete epochs bracketed by consecutive observed native epoch-summary timestamps inside the intersection of client measurement windows

evaluation.attribution_reason: SQL source has a total retry counter, not a per-cause SQL counter; KV cause counts are separately named even when the identity holds

sql_retry_cause_identity.interpretation: KV causes and SQL retry total have different instrumentation/terminal boundaries. Equality is an observed same-scrape-window identity, not per-SQL cause instrumentation; histogram_count counts transactions, not retries

terminal_40001_per_client_terminal.window: client logical transactions fully inside measurement

visible_40001_per_client_attempt.window: client SQL attempts fully inside measurement

measurement.semantics: Execution start to terminal completion, including retries; excludes capacity waiting and unfinished-at-end transactions; per-process windows retained

figure_semantics: Achieved throughput and independently defined numerator/denominator windows; per-cell points, not a paired-block estimator

4dec8f5bfc1f3e71827c-r000.continuity: Discrete verified snapshots plus final map; movement away and back between snapshots is not excluded
